policy.identity: Exact original2024–25 CCD LEA1200480/nativeFL-16 and native district16 school codes. Remove only documented FL- prefix from CCD FL-16-#### to native16-####; retain authoritative12digit NCES separately. Padded official numeric school codes join original native collections; names, corrected digits and guessed crosswalks never establish ownership.
policy.population: Prospective pure lower source profiles require exact operational CCD ownership, complete unadjusted reported PK–8 offers with grade3–8 and no9–13/UG/AE, original Fall Survey2 explicitzero in every9–12 and at leastone positive or protected-positive native enrolled grade3–8. Offered and enrolled grades remain separate. Primary-only/zero-tested/mixed/high/uncertain configurations stay outside; planning, income extremes, school-type labels and fit quality never select scope. Native assessment can include belowgrade3 pupils testing abovegrade; preserve that original scope without inferring participation in a profile with onlyzero tested-grade enrollment.
policy.income: Florida 2024–25 Final Survey 3 (February) raw individual Lunch Status counts: D/F free eligibility + 3/E reduced eligibility + C/R CEP direct certification, divided by same-survey enrolled students (PK–12). Never uses the USDA 1.6-adjusted federal funding numerator or published school-grade economic percentage. CEP N means not individually identified eligible and is excluded from the numerator. Provision 2 code 4 reports all enrolled students, so schools with nonzero or masked code 4 have unavailable income. At CEP schools this proxy counts direct certification/household extension rather than a complete income survey of all families; undercount and reporting coverage are unknown. No other-year backfill.
policy.income_codes: The2024–25 primary LunchStatus146025 definition requires districtoption6/9 conversion toC/D before state reporting. Preserve raw workbook D/F,3/E,C/R and code4 fields; never add unreported categories, use multiplier1.6/federal funding columns9–11, or substitute SchoolGrades economic percentage53. Rawcoded eligibility and unknown CEP identification coverage remain proxy limitations.
policy.assessment: 2024–25 native School Grades English Language Arts Achievement and Mathematics Achievement components: Level 3 or above / valid assessed students under Florida full-year-enrollment and home-zoned attribution rules, including eligible FAA Performance Task but excluding FAA Datafolio. ELA FAST PM3 grades 3–10 and Math FAST PM3 grades 3–8 plus B.E.S.T./Access Algebra 1/Geometry EOCs; this cohort enrolls no grades 9–12 in the same-year Survey 2 registry. ELL included after two US-school years; medical/extraordinary exemptions excluded. Components require at least 10 eligible students. Native whole-percent rates only; score denominators absent, so all model sampling intervals unavailable. Collocated combined results and provider-specific virtual rates are excluded from individual-school matches.
policy.native_population: Original SchoolGrades2025 published MathAchievement column9 and ELA column6, Level3 orabove among valid accountable assessed students; use native whole percentages without component averaging or count-ratio substitution. ELA can include belowgrade3 pupils testing abovegrade; native Math includes prescribed BEST/Access Algebra1/Geometry EOC scope. Full-year enrollment/home-zoned/ELL-after2USschoolyears/medical-exemption/eligibleFAAperformance and separateDatafolio attribution remain original limitations. Registry profile scope does not prove exact test administration membership.
policy.suppression: Protected native Fall counts remain unavailable numeric counts and positive presence, never zero or reconstructed. Missing/masked income or achievement stays unavailable. Explicit reported zeros remainzero. Never complement masks or backfill another year.
policy.counts: Native whole-percent SchoolGrades has no verified valid-score denominators. The primaryguide at least10eligible component condition does not certify every member has10valid-scored students. Every tested/valid-score count, variance and interval remainsnull/unavailable, with scoredfloor uncertified. Enrollment, publishedpercent tested, federal95%adjustment and studentization never substitute.
policy.combined: Equally weighted mean of usable original Math and ELA published rates with own same-year individual income; not percentage proficient inboth.
policy.income_enrollment_discrepancy: Own Final Survey3 February PK–12 denominator differs from Fall Survey2/CCD and full-year accountable achievement. CCD district130054 versus operational school sum129932 differs122; native-only16-0734 Fall PK122 and February132 are preserved without attributing the cause or inventing a CCD identity.
policy.eligibility: Reconstruct exact original CCD and native district 16 identities, operational status and complete pure lower offered flags. Require native Fall grades 9–12 to be explicit zero and at least one grade 3–8 positive or protected-positive. Compute own February D/F + 3/E + C/R count ratio only with explicit-zero Provision 2 code 4. Select exact campus published Math/ELA fields without provider-specific or collocated attribution. Retain all 150 prospective profiles; four missing outcomes exclude only their unavailable subject models. Charters, income extremes and influence never select membership.
policy.models: Separate unweighted centered 2024–25 Duval grade-school Math, ELA and Combined OLS. Combined independently fits the paired 146 original-rate means with its own residual scale, deletions and external studentization. Equal subject cohorts may yield linear coefficient averages but never justify averaging studentized scores. No weights, enrollment adjustment, fit-driven exclusions or national pooling.
policy.studentization: Externally studentized residuals use every explicit deleted-school fit and N−3 residual degrees of freedom, independent centered full fits and held-out leverage. Cook distance and prediction sensitivity over the observed income range are descriptive, never exclusions or clamping.
policy.intervals: All valid-score counts, sampling variances and interval endpoints are null modelwide; the ten-valid-scored floor is uncertified. An internal zero variance vector is solely a point-estimate computational sentinel, never an uncertainty estimate.
policy.compact_provenance: Complete committed immutable source retains all 2,495 original records / 59,985 typed cells, complete headers, notes, primary definitions and outside identities. Exact whole blob, source code/tests/policy/raw/schema/definition/identity fingerprints and current semantic replay are required on every numerical replay, including cached expected fits. Exact inputs and table/workbook/worksheet/row/column references replace repeated raw tables/PDFs.
policy.release: Numerical audit only pending independent review and separate canonical/browser integration. Historical source and numerical source/modeling approvals remain false; high/mixed/primary/missing/closed/unmatched scopes and count holds remain unreleased.

retained_source_reference.note: Complete original records, headers, notes, definitions, membership and outside identities stay in the immutable linked source artifact; every numerical replay requires current available unchanged source/code/tests/policy and semantic validation.
